schemas.name: Box
schemas.doc: An axis-aligned box centred on the origin.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Full extents along X, Y and Z.

schemas.name: BoxCollider
schemas.doc: A box collision shape.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient.

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness, 0 to 1.

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: A sensor reports collisions but pushes nothing.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Full extents along X, Y and Z.

schemas.name: Camera
schemas.doc: The fields of a `camera`. Looks along local -Z, or at `target` when declared.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Marks the active camera; optional with one camera, exactly one `active: true` with several.

fields.name: exposure
fields.doc: EV100; lit materials scale by 1 / (1.2 * 2^exposure). Default -log2(1.2 * pi): white under 1 lux shows white; a sunny day (about 100 000 lux) is about 15.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Camera position in world space, in metres.

fields.name: projection
fields.doc: `Perspective {..}` or `Orthographic {..}`; the kind is construction-only, its fields writable and bindable.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Orientation when no `target` is declared.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Optional point to look at (up is +Y); excludes `rotation`.

schemas.name: CapsuleCollider
schemas.doc: A capsule shape: a cylinder along local Y capped by hemispheres.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Full height including both caps; > 2 * `radius`.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius in metres.

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness, 0 to 1.

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: A sensor reports collisions but pushes nothing.

schemas.name: DirectionalLight
schemas.doc: A light infinitely far away. Travels along the entity's world -Z axis; rotate the entity to aim it.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Light colour (linear RGB; alpha is ignored).

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Illuminance in lux.

schemas.name: Dynamic
schemas.doc: A solver-controlled body; forces, impulses and teleports are explicit commands.

fields.name: angular_damping
fields.doc: Rate at which angular velocity decays.

fields.name: continuous
fields.doc: Continuous collision detection for this body.

fields.name: linear_damping
fields.doc: Rate at which linear velocity decays.

fields.name: mass
fields.doc: Mass in kilograms.

schemas.name: Emitter
schemas.doc: A bounded particle emitter: at most 64 particles, `rate` per second, in a hemisphere around the entity's up axis.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Downward acceleration in metres per second squared.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.doc: How long each particle lives, in seconds.

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: Particles spawned per second. A fraction carries to the next frame.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Billboard size in metres.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Initial speed in metres per second.

schemas.name: Entity
schemas.doc: Entity/prefab: a named transform with optional components.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: A physics body (`Static`, `Dynamic`, `Kinematic`). Root entities only; requires `collider`.

fields.name: bounds_center
fields.doc: Final deformed local sphere center; used when bounds_radius > 0.

fields.name: bounds_radius
fields.doc: Enclose every final local vertex/pose; 0 uses mesh/skin bounds, or unbounded authored vertices.

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: A glTF animation name that moves this entity; the mesh must come from that file.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: A collision shape (`BoxCollider`, `SphereCollider`, `CapsuleCollider`). Requires `body`.

fields.name: light
fields.doc: A light (`DirectionalLight`, `PointLight`); its fields are writable and bindable. Named entities only.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: Material instance; a value-only one can be replaced by the same material type; params are writable and bindable. Requires `mesh`.

fields.name: mesh
fields.doc: The mesh drawn: a descriptor (`Box`, `Sphere`, `Plane`) or an asset mesh.

fields.name: particles
fields.doc: A particle emitter: up to 64 camera-facing billboards of this entity's mesh in its material's colour; counted even without a mesh.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Position local to the parent, in metres.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Rotation local to the parent.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Parent-local scale; construction-only on bodies, `vec3(1.0)` on dynamic and kinematic ones.

fields.name: tag
fields.doc: A group name (`"rock"`: lowercase letters, digits, `_`) for `count_tagged`, `first_tagged`, `nearest_tagged`, `tagged`, `has_tag` and `destroy_tagged`.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: Hide the mesh; behavior keeps running.

schemas.name: Kinematic
schemas.doc: Program-moved body: `set_kinematic_target`, or `move_character` with collisions. Fields tune `move_character`.

fields.name: carry
fields.doc: Moving platforms carry the character.

fields.name: max_slope
fields.doc: Steepest climbable slope in radians.

fields.name: skin
fields.doc: Gap kept from contacts in metres.

fields.name: snap_to_ground
fields.doc: Longest snap-down in metres; 0 disables.

fields.name: step_height
fields.doc: Highest step climbed in metres; 0 disables.

fields.name: step_min_width
fields.doc: Narrowest tread stepped onto in metres.

schemas.name: Orthographic
schemas.doc: An orthographic projection (right-handed, clip depth 0 to 1).

fields.name: far
fields.doc: Distance to the far plane.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height of the view volume in world units; width follows the aspect ratio.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Distance to the near plane.

schemas.name: Pbr
schemas.doc: Metallic-roughness PBR with optional scene shadows and environment lighting.

fields.name: base_color
fields.doc: Linear base colour multiplied with the base colour texture.

fields.name: base_color_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler for the base colour texture.

fields.name: base_color_texture
fields.doc: Base colour texture.

fields.name: emissive
fields.doc: Linear emission before exposure.

fields.name: emissive_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler of the emissive map.

fields.name: emissive_texture
fields.doc: sRGB emissive colour, multiplied by emissive.

fields.name: metallic
fields.doc: Metalness; clamped to 0..1 by the lighting model.

fields.name: metallic_roughness_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler of the metallic_roughness map.

fields.name: metallic_roughness_texture
fields.doc: Linear green roughness and blue metallic factors.

fields.name: normal_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler of the normal map.

fields.name: normal_scale
fields.doc: Normal XY scale; zero suits the white fallback. GLB map default: one.

fields.name: normal_texture
fields.doc: Linear tangent-space normal map; enable with normal_scale.

fields.name: occlusion_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler of the occlusion map.

fields.name: occlusion_strength
fields.doc: Indirect-light occlusion strength, clamped to 0..1.

fields.name: occlusion_texture
fields.doc: Linear red indirect-light occlusion.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Perceptual roughness; clamped to 0.045..1 by the lighting model.

schemas.name: Perspective
schemas.doc: A perspective projection (right-handed, clip depth 0 to 1).

fields.name: far
fields.doc: Distance to the far plane.

fields.name: fov_y
fields.doc: Full vertical field of view in radians.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Distance to the near plane.

schemas.name: Plane
schemas.doc: A single-sided horizontal plane at y = 0 facing +Y.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Extent along X and Z.

schemas.name: PointLight
schemas.doc: A light radiating from the entity's world position.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Light colour (linear RGB; alpha is ignored).

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Luminous intensity in candela.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: Distance at which the light fades to nothing; 0 means unlimited.

schemas.name: Scene
schemas.doc: The fields of a scene: all construction-only constant expressions.

fields.name: ambient_color
fields.doc: Colour of the ambient light; only RGB is used.

fields.name: ambient_intensity
fields.doc: Ambient light scale for lit materials; 0 is off. Multiplied by the camera's exposure scale (about 3.14 by default), so 0.3 is near full brightness on white. Unlit ignores it.

fields.name: clear_color
fields.doc: Colour the canvas is cleared to; only RGB is used.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Gravitational acceleration in m/s^2; used only with physics bodies.

schemas.name: Sphere
schemas.doc: A UV sphere centred on the origin.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius in metres.

fields.name: rings
fields.doc: Subdivisions from pole to pole.

fields.name: segments
fields.doc: Subdivisions around the Y axis.

schemas.name: SphereCollider
schemas.doc: A sphere collision shape.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius in metres.

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness, 0 to 1.

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: A sensor reports collisions but pushes nothing.

schemas.name: Sprite
schemas.doc: One frame of a sprite sheet, tinted; always translucent.

fields.name: cell
fields.doc: Cell (animation frame) shown, from 0, row by row; floored and wrapped, so `bind(t * fps)` animates.

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Cells per row of the sheet.

fields.name: rows
fields.doc: Rows of cells in the sheet.

fields.name: sheet
fields.doc: The sprite sheet: `columns` x `rows` equal cells.

fields.name: sheet_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler of the sheet (default nearest, clamped).

fields.name: tint
fields.doc: Multiplies the texel, alpha included.

schemas.name: Static
schemas.doc: An immovable body; its pose is fixed at creation from the entity transform.

schemas.name: Unlit
schemas.doc: Flat colour, no lighting.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: The colour written to the canvas.

events.name: collision_enter
events.doc: Its collider started touching another; the parameter is that entity.

events.name: collision_exit
events.doc: Its collider stopped touching another; the parameter is that entity.

events.name: key_down
events.doc: Delivered when the filtered key transitions to pressed. Auto-repeat is ignored.

events.name: key_up
events.doc: Delivered when the filtered key is released.

events.name: message
events.doc: A queued string sent to this entity; delivered before its next unpaused update.

events.name: pointer_down
events.doc: A pointer button was pressed on the canvas.

events.name: pointer_move
events.doc: The pointer moved; at most once per frame with the latest position.

enums.name: Key
enums.doc: A physical key, layout-independent. Written `Key.<Member>` with exactly the members listed (`Key.Space`, `Key.ArrowUp`, `Key.A`, `Key.Digit1`); there is no `Key.Up`, `Key.KeyA` or `Key.Shift`.

intrinsics.name: abs
intrinsics.doc: Absolute value, component-wise.

intrinsics.name: acos
intrinsics.doc: Arc cosine, in radians.

intrinsics.name: alive
intrinsics.doc: Whether the entity reference points at a live entity.

intrinsics.name: asin
intrinsics.doc: Arc sine, in radians.

intrinsics.name: atan
intrinsics.doc: Arc tangent, in radians.

intrinsics.name: atan2
intrinsics.doc: Angle of the point `(x, y)` in radians; note the argument order `atan2(y, x)`.

intrinsics.name: ceil
intrinsics.doc: Smallest integer value not below `x`.

intrinsics.name: chance
intrinsics.doc: True with probability `p`.

intrinsics.name: choose
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: One draw of `random()`: index `floor(random() * N)`. `N` is at least 1.
intrinsics.doc: One element of an array, chosen uniformly.

intrinsics.name: clamp
signatures: (x: T, lo: T, hi: T) -> T
(x: I, lo: I, hi: I) -> I
intrinsics.doc: Limits `x` to the range `lo..hi`.

intrinsics.name: clear_saved
intrinsics.doc: Deletes everything stored.

intrinsics.name: cos
intrinsics.doc: Cosine of an angle in radians.

intrinsics.name: count_tagged
intrinsics.doc: The number of live entities with the tag.

intrinsics.name: cross
intrinsics.doc: Cross product of two 3D vectors.

intrinsics.name: degrees
intrinsics.doc: Radians to degrees.

intrinsics.name: destroy
intrinsics.doc: Queues removal of a spawned entity; it counts as dead at once.

intrinsics.name: destroy_tagged
intrinsics.doc: Queues removal of every live spawned entity with the tag (not a tag of a named entity).

intrinsics.name: distance
intrinsics.doc: Distance between two points.

intrinsics.name: dot
intrinsics.doc: Dot product of two vectors.

intrinsics.name: exp
intrinsics.doc: e raised to `x`.

intrinsics.name: exp2
intrinsics.doc: 2 raised to `x`.

intrinsics.name: first_tagged
intrinsics.doc: The first live entity with the tag in instance order; a dead reference if there is none.

intrinsics.name: floor
intrinsics.doc: Largest integer value not above `x`.

intrinsics.name: fract
intrinsics.doc: Fractional part of `x`.

intrinsics.name: go_to
intrinsics.doc: Switches scene, keeping shared state.

intrinsics.name: has_tag
intrinsics.doc: Whether the entity is live and has the tag.

intrinsics.name: inverse_sqrt
intrinsics.doc: Reciprocal of the square root.

intrinsics.name: is_key_down
intrinsics.doc: Whether the key was down at the end of input handling this frame.

intrinsics.name: is_muted
intrinsics.doc: Whether audio is muted with `set_muted`.

intrinsics.name: is_pointer_down
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: 0 primary, 1 middle, 2 secondary. Any other button is false.
intrinsics.doc: Whether pointer button `button` was down at the end of input handling.

intrinsics.name: key_pressed
intrinsics.doc: Whether the key went down during input handling of the current frame.

intrinsics.name: key_released
intrinsics.doc: Whether the key went up during input handling of the current frame.

intrinsics.name: length
intrinsics.doc: Length of a vector, or the absolute value of a scalar.

intrinsics.name: load
intrinsics.doc: Reads saved values back; false if none.

intrinsics.name: log
intrinsics.doc: Natural logarithm.

intrinsics.name: log2
intrinsics.doc: Base-2 logarithm.

intrinsics.name: max
intrinsics.doc: Larger of two values, component-wise.

intrinsics.name: min
intrinsics.doc: Smaller of two values, component-wise.

intrinsics.name: mix
signatures: (a: T, b: T, t: T) -> T
intrinsics.doc: Linear interpolation `a * (1 - t) + b * t`, with a scalar or a component-wise `t`.

intrinsics.name: nearest_tagged
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: Ties go to the first in instance order.
intrinsics.doc: The live entity with the tag whose world position is nearest `point`; a dead reference if there is none.

intrinsics.name: normalize
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: A zero vector, or one whose squared length underflows or overflows, gives the zero vector on the CPU and the GPU (decision 0047).
intrinsics.doc: The vector scaled to length 1.

intrinsics.name: overlap_boxes
signatures: (a: vec3, size_a: vec3, rotation_a: quat, b: vec3, size_b: vec3, rotation_b: quat) -> bool
intrinsics.doc: Oriented box intersection from world centres, full sizes and rotations. No physics needed.

intrinsics.name: overlap_spheres
signatures: (a: vec3, radius_a: f32, b: vec3, radius_b: f32) -> bool
intrinsics.doc: World-space sphere intersection, including touching. No physics required.

intrinsics.name: particle_count
intrinsics.doc: How many particles are alive.

intrinsics.name: pause
intrinsics.doc: Stops update, physics and timers; input goes on.

intrinsics.name: paused
intrinsics.doc: Whether paused.

intrinsics.name: play
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: Web Audio; silent until the first user input unlocks audio (spec/audio.md section 5).
intrinsics.doc: Plays a sound once with `volume` (default 1.0, range 0..4) and `pitch` (rate, default 1.0, range 0.0625..16).

intrinsics.name: play_at
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: A Web Audio PannerNode (HRTF off, inverse distance, reference distance 1 m); the listener follows the active camera each frame.
intrinsics.doc: Plays a sound once at a world position: quieter with distance from the active camera, and panned.

intrinsics.name: play_music
intrinsics.doc: Starts a sound as looping music, replacing the current music.

intrinsics.name: pointer_position
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: `x` right, `y` up, both in `[-1, 1]`. `(0, 0)` until the pointer moves or a button changes.
intrinsics.doc: The pointer position at the end of input handling, in canvas NDC.

intrinsics.name: pow
intrinsics.doc: `base` raised to `exponent`, component-wise.

intrinsics.name: print
intrinsics.doc: Writes a message to the development console.

intrinsics.name: radians
intrinsics.doc: Degrees to radians.

intrinsics.name: random
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: Seeded PRNG (xoshiro128**, seed from the mount options); deterministic under a fixed seed.
intrinsics.doc: A pseudo-random number in `[0, 1)`.

intrinsics.name: random_int
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: `lo + floor(random() * (hi - lo))` in f64; one draw, also when `hi <= lo`.
intrinsics.doc: A random i32 in `[lo, hi)`; `lo` if `hi <= lo`.

intrinsics.name: random_range
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: `lo + (hi - lo) * random()`, rounded to f32; one draw.
intrinsics.doc: A random f32 in `[lo, hi)`.

intrinsics.name: reflect
intrinsics.doc: Reflects incident vector `i` about the surface normal `n`.

intrinsics.name: reset
intrinsics.doc: Next frame, restarts the scene.

intrinsics.name: resume
intrinsics.doc: Undoes pause().

intrinsics.name: round
intrinsics.doc: Nearest integer value, halves to even.

intrinsics.name: sample
signatures: (t: texture, s: sampler, uv: vec2) -> vec4
intrinsics.doc: Level-zero texel of `t` at `uv`. Texture/sampler params are direct operands of `sample` or `sample_mip` only.

intrinsics.name: sample_mip
signatures: (t: texture, s: sampler, uv: vec2) -> vec4
intrinsics.doc: Implicit mip texel; fragment initial straight-line code only. Resource rules as for `sample`.

intrinsics.name: saturate
intrinsics.doc: Limits `x` to 0..1.

intrinsics.name: save
intrinsics.doc: Writes the saved and setting state to storage.

intrinsics.name: screen_to_world
intrinsics.doc: Canvas NDC to the world Z plane `z`; parallel rays return NaN x/y.

intrinsics.name: send
intrinsics.doc: Queues a string for a live entity's `on message(value: string)` handler.

intrinsics.name: set_camera
intrinsics.doc: Switches the active camera.

intrinsics.name: set_muted
intrinsics.doc: Mutes or unmutes all audio; the volume is kept.

intrinsics.name: set_volume
intrinsics.doc: Sets the global volume of every sound and the music (default 1.0, range 0..4).

intrinsics.name: shuffle
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: Fisher-Yates: `N - 1` draws of `random()` (`N` below 2 draws none). Does not modify `items`.
intrinsics.doc: A new array with the same elements in a random order.

intrinsics.name: sign
intrinsics.doc: -1, 0 or 1 according to the sign of `x`.

intrinsics.name: sin
intrinsics.doc: Sine of an angle in radians.

intrinsics.name: smoothstep
signatures: (edge0: T, edge1: T, x: T) -> T
intrinsics.doc: Smooth Hermite interpolation between `edge0` and `edge1`.

intrinsics.name: spawn
intrinsics.doc: Queues a prefab instance as a root entity; the reference is valid at once and `alive` turns true after the next flush.

intrinsics.name: sqrt
intrinsics.doc: Square root.

intrinsics.name: step
intrinsics.doc: 0 where `x < edge`, otherwise 1, component-wise. WGSL argument order: `step(edge, x)`.

intrinsics.name: stop_music
intrinsics.doc: Stops the music started with `play_music`; does nothing when none plays.

intrinsics.name: tagged
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: The loop skips an entity that is destroyed before its turn and does not visit one spawned during the loop.
intrinsics.doc: The live entities with the tag in instance order; only a `for` iterable.

intrinsics.name: tan
intrinsics.doc: Tangent of an angle in radians.

intrinsics.name: transpose
intrinsics.doc: Transpose of a 4x4 matrix.

intrinsics.name: trunc
intrinsics.doc: Integer part of `x`, rounding toward zero.

intrinsics.name: world_to_screen
intrinsics.doc: World position to canvas NDC, using the active camera and viewport.

namespaces.name: animation
namespaces.doc: Controls an entity's imported node clip (decision 0190).

members.name: copy_pose
members.doc: Copies and holds the displayed pose of a compatible skeleton; a later transition blends from it.

members.name: crossed
members.doc: Whether a marker in (0, duration] was crossed in the latest update, including loop wraps. Not consumed by reading.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Clip duration in seconds; zero for an unavailable clip.

members.name: fade
signatures: (target: entity_ref, weight: f32, duration: f32) -> bool
members.doc: Blends clip weight toward a 0..1 target over seconds; zero applies at once.

members.name: finished
members.doc: Whether a one-shot clip reached its end.

members.name: joint_position
members.doc: Joint position in the skeletal mesh local space; zero if missing.

members.name: joint_rotation
members.doc: Joint rotation in skeletal mesh local space; identity if missing.

members.name: pause
members.doc: Freezes clip time; fades continue during scene updates.

members.name: play
signatures: (target: entity_ref, looping: bool, speed: f32) -> bool
members.doc: Restarts the clip. Speed must be finite and nonnegative. Returns false for an unavailable clip.

members.name: playing
members.doc: Whether clip time is advancing; false for an unavailable clip.

members.name: resume
members.doc: Continues a paused clip; returns false for a finished clip.

members.name: seek
members.doc: Clamps time to the clip duration and applies the pose at once, crossing no markers and not resuming.

members.name: time
members.doc: Current clip time in seconds; zero for an unavailable clip.

members.name: transition
signatures: (target: entity_ref, name: string, seconds: f32, looping: bool, speed: f32) -> bool
members.doc: Selects a skeletal clip, crossfading from the current pose; the current name does not restart (use play).

members.name: weight
members.doc: Current clip weight; zero for an unavailable clip.

namespaces.name: asset
namespaces.doc: Compile-time asset declarations. The argument must be a string literal naming a file inside the project.

members.name: font
members.doc: A font file (`.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff` or `.woff2`) for `hud.text`.

members.name: glb
members.doc: A static GLB model; only in a `const`, used through its accessors.

members.name: linear_texture
members.doc: A linear data texture (masks, normal data).

members.name: sound
members.doc: A sound file (`.wav`, `.ogg` or `.mp3`) for `play`, `play_at` and `play_music`.

members.name: texture
members.doc: An sRGB colour texture.

members.name: linear
members.doc: A colour from linear-light components.

members.name: srgb
members.cpuSemantics: Per channel `c <= 0.04045 ? c / 12.92 : powf((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4)`, every operation rounded to `f32`; alpha unchanged. Constant folding uses `libm::powf` (deterministic); run time agrees within the CPU/GPU tolerance. `#rrggbb` literals use the exact `f64` conversion instead and may differ in the last bit.
members.doc: A colour from sRGB-encoded components, converted to linear light.

namespaces.name: easing
namespaces.doc: Easing curves for tweens: `mix(a, b, easing.out_cubic(t))` moves from `a` to `b` as `t` goes from 0 to 1.

members.name: in_cubic
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing t³; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: in_out_cubic
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing cubic in, then out; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: in_out_quad
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing quadratic in, then out; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: in_out_sine
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing (1 − cos(π t)) / 2; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: in_quad
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing t²; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: out_back
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing overshoots slightly past 1, then settles; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: out_bounce
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing bounces at 1 like a dropped ball; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: out_cubic
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing 1 − (1 − t)³; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: out_elastic
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing springs past 1 and oscillates to rest; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

members.name: out_quad
members.cpuSemantics: Binary64 arithmetic on the clamped argument, rounded once to f32.
members.doc: Easing 1 − (1 − t)²; `t` is clamped to 0..1, the result is 0 at 0 and 1 at 1.

namespaces.name: frame
namespaces.doc: Per-frame CPU/`bind` values; route to GPU stages through material params. `update(dt)` gets the variable frame delta; `fixed_update(dt)` runs zero or more times per frame with a constant step (default 1/60 s).

members.name: delta
members.doc: The clamped frame delta passed to `update`.

members.name: index
members.doc: Rendered frame counter since mount, wrapping.

members.name: time
members.doc: Active application time in seconds since mount, excluding paused time.

namespaces.name: hud
namespaces.doc: The heads-up display: text, rectangles and buttons drawn over the canvas. Immediate mode: what a frame draws is shown until the next frame, so draw from `update`.

members.name: button
signatures: (label: string, at: vec2, size: f32) -> bool
members.cpuSemantics: A DOM button over the canvas; clicks are queued and reported by the next frame's call.
members.doc: Draws a button centred at `at` (canvas NDC) labelled `label` (`size` CSS pixels, default 24.0). Returns true in the frame after a click, once per click; buttons are told apart by label and order.

members.name: pixel_font
members.cpuSemantics: Returns the built-in font; draws nothing.
members.doc: The built-in 5x7 pixel bitmap font of printable ASCII; other characters show as a box.

members.name: rect
signatures: (at: vec2, size: vec2, tint: color, align: f32) -> ()
members.cpuSemantics: A DOM element over the canvas.
members.doc: Draws a filled rectangle of `size` CSS pixels at `at` (canvas NDC), aligned like `hud.text` (default centred).

members.name: text
signatures: (content: string, at: vec2, size: f32, tint: color) -> ()
(content: string, at: vec2, size: f32, tint: color, align: f32) -> ()
(content: string, at: vec2, size: f32, tint: color, align: f32, font: font) -> ()
members.cpuSemantics: A DOM element over the canvas; the text is set as text, never as HTML.
members.doc: Draws a line of text at `at` (canvas NDC, y up): `size` CSS pixels (default 24.0), `tint` (default white), `align` 0.0 left edge, 0.5 centre (default), 1.0 right edge, `font` an `asset.font(..)` or `hud.pixel_font()` (default: page sans-serif). Centred vertically on `at`.

types.name: PointerEvent
types.doc: A pointer event: `position` in canvas coordinates (x right, y up, -1..1) and the `button` (0 primary, 1 middle, 2 secondary).

types.name: SurfaceInput
types.doc: Interpolated fragment inputs.

types.name: VertexInput
types.doc: Skinned local vertex inputs.

types.name: array
types.doc: The generic `array<T, N>`: a fixed-length array of `N` (1 to 65536) elements of type `T`.

types.name: bool
types.doc: Truth value.

types.name: color
types.doc: Linear RGBA, straight alpha; not a `vec4`. A literal `#rrggbb` is sRGB, converted; `color.linear(rgb, a)` takes linear components, `color.srgb(rgb, a)` sRGB ones. Fields `.r .g .b .a`, `.rgb`; no arithmetic.

types.name: entity_ref
types.doc: A generation-checked reference to an entity. Compare it, test `alive`, `destroy` it, command its body, and read `position`, `rotation`, `scale` and `visible`.

types.name: f32
types.doc: IEEE-754 binary32 floating-point number.

types.name: font
types.doc: A font for `hud.text`: `asset.font(..)` or the built-in `hud.pixel_font()`; CPU only (decision 0139).

types.name: glb_asset
types.doc: The compile-time handle of `asset.glb(..)`; may be stored only in a `const` and used through its accessors.

methods.name: material
methods.doc: The glTF material with this name as a `Pbr` instance with every parameter taken from the file.

methods.name: material_base_color
methods.doc: The linear `baseColorFactor` of the material; alpha must be 1.

methods.name: material_texture
methods.doc: The `baseColorTexture` of the material, or `texture.white()` when absent.

methods.name: mesh
methods.doc: The glTF mesh with this name; it must have exactly one primitive.

methods.name: node_position
methods.doc: World position of the node in the default scene.

methods.name: node_rotation
methods.doc: World rotation of the node in the default scene.

methods.name: node_scale
methods.doc: World scale of the node in the default scene.

methods.name: primitive
methods.doc: Primitive `index` (an integer literal) of the named glTF mesh.

types.name: i32
types.doc: 32-bit signed integer.

types.name: mat4
types.doc: 4x4 `f32` matrix, column-major; multiplies column vectors on the right.

types.name: material
types.doc: A material instance with its own parameter storage.

types.name: mesh
types.doc: An immutable mesh: a primitive descriptor or an asset mesh.

types.name: quat
types.doc: Unit quaternion `(x, y, z, w)`; distinct from `vec4`.

types.name: sampler
types.doc: A sampler preset. Usable only as a material parameter.

types.name: sound
types.doc: A sound file declared with `asset.sound(..)`; CPU only. Played with `play`, `play_at` and `play_music` (decision 0130).

types.name: string
types.doc: Immutable text. CPU only.

types.name: texture
types.doc: An immutable texture. Usable only as a material parameter.

types.name: u32
types.doc: 32-bit unsigned integer.

types.name: vec2
types.doc: Two `f32` components.

types.name: vec3
types.doc: Three `f32` components.

types.name: vec4

sceneObjects.doc: Declares a camera: `camera Main { .. }`. A scene needs exactly one active camera.

bodyCommands.name: apply_force
bodyCommands.doc: A force in newtons applied for exactly the next tick, then cleared.

bodyCommands.name: apply_impulse
bodyCommands.doc: Instantaneous change of momentum in newton-seconds, at the centre of mass, applied at the start of the next tick.

bodyCommands.name: move_character
bodyCommands.doc: Moves the body by `displacement` metres for this tick, sliding along what it meets, stepping up stairs, staying on slopes and ground and riding a moving kinematic platform, then turns it to `rotation`. Gravity is not applied; add your own vertical motion. Several calls in one tick sum their displacements and the last rotation wins; the move replaces `set_kinematic_target` of the same tick (decisions 0214, 0217).

bodyCommands.name: set_kinematic_target
bodyCommands.doc: The pose reached at the end of the next tick; the solver derives the velocity.

bodyCommands.name: set_linear_velocity
bodyCommands.doc: Sets the linear velocity at the start of the next tick.

bodyCommands.name: teleport
bodyCommands.doc: Sets the pose before the next tick; velocities are zeroed unless `keep_velocity` is true.

bodyProperties.name: angular_velocity
bodyProperties.doc: Angular velocity as of the last completed tick. Read-only.

bodyProperties.name: ground_normal
bodyProperties.doc: Ground normal of the last `move_character`; zero in the air. Read-only.

bodyProperties.name: grounded
bodyProperties.doc: Ground found by the last completed `move_character`. Read-only.

bodyProperties.name: linear_velocity
bodyProperties.doc: Linear velocity as of the last completed tick. Read-only.
